summary: Adds journal_entries.prior_period_through (nullable date), a presentation flag: statements show flagged entries, and conversion re-posts, apart from the month's operating results on a 'Prior-period items recorded this month' line; year to date keeps them in their accounts. Backfills Canyon Gate's six reserve reclassification entries of pre-cutover spending (JE-2026-00455, 457, 458, 459 dated 8/1; 460, 461 dated 9/1) with 2026-07-31. No amount, account, fund or date changes; posts nothing.

preflight.name: the column does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'journal_entries' AND column_name = 'prior_period_through'

preflight.name: the six Canyon Gate reclassification entries exist exactly once each, posted
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM journal_entries WHERE community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003' AND reference IN ('JE-2026-00455','JE-2026-00457','JE-2026-00458','JE-2026-00459','JE-2026-00460','JE-2026-00461') AND status = 'posted'

expected_changes: journal_entries: adds nullable column prior_period_through (date) with a comment.
journal_entries: sets prior_period_through = 2026-07-31 on the six Canyon Gate reserve reclassification entries; no other column or row changes.

verify.name: the column exists
